facts: On a real iPhone Mobium refuses permissions, appearance, the clipboard, simulated location and routes, and notifications, reading or posting them.
simctl does these on a simulator and devicectl has no equivalent, so on a phone each is refused with the reason rather than approximated.
Clearing an app's data is done differently on a phone: given the app's .app or .ipa (--bundle), Mobium uninstalls and reinstalls it, since nothing can delete from its container in place.
note: SETUP 'What a phone cannot do' alone, checked against internal/mobiumdriver/wdaphone.go:199-220 (simulatorOnly and phoneRemedies list exactly these, clear-data included).
